diagnosis: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL), Non-GCB subtype (Activated B-cell-like, ABC, established by Hans algorithm: CD10-, BCL6+, MUM1+).
stage: Lugano Stage IV (disseminated disease with cervical and mediastinal nodal involvement, bulky retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy measuring 11 cm, and FDG-avid splenic extranodal lesions, with no bone marrow or CNS involvement).
biology: Double-expressor lymphoma (DEL) with high expression of BCL2 (80%) and MYC (50%), and high proliferative index (Ki-67 ~85%). Fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) confirms absence of MYC, BCL2, and BCL6 structural rearrangements, ruling out double-hit or triple-hit high-grade B-cell lymphoma.
prognosis: International Prognostic Index (IPI) score of 3 (High-Intermediate risk), driven by age (62 years), elevated LDH (680 U/L), Ann Arbor Stage IV, and high-intermediate risk category. Associated with an estimated 5-year progression-free survival of approximately 50-55%.
first_line_treatment: R-CHOP (Rituximab, Cyclophosphamide, Doxorubicin, Vincristine, Prednisone) for 6 cycles, or Pola-R-CHP (Polatuzumab vedotin combined with rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, and prednisone) given the high-intermediate IPI risk and bulky disease presentation.
cns_risk: Moderate to High CNS-relapse risk based on elevated LDH, advanced Lugano stage IV, high IPI score, and bulky retroperitoneal adenopathy. Consideration of CNS staging (lumbar puncture) and discussion of CNS-directed prophylaxis or close surveillance is warranted.
response_assessment: Interim FDG PET-CT after 4 cycles and end-of-treatment FDG PET-CT after completion of 6 cycles, evaluated using the Lugano Classification (Deauville 5-Point Scale where Deauville scores 1-3 indicate complete metabolic response).
missing_information: Baseline hepatitis B serologies (HBsAg, anti-HBc), HIV status, cardiac ejection fraction assessment (ECHO/MUGA) prior to anthracycline therapy, baseline performance of diagnostic lumbar puncture/CSF cytology for CNS staging, and exact upper limit of normal (ULN) for LDH.
